> Kloudbean is a managed cloud hosting platform that runs your whole stack from one dashboard: application servers, managed databases, S3-compatible object…

It provisions on seven cloud providers and has shipped monthly since November 2023. Applications run always-on as persistent processes rather than scale-to-zero functions, so there are no cold starts. Pricing is flat from $8/mo and egress isn't metered.
